name: atlas-balancing-game
description: A silly physics game about stacking the world's junk on the back of Atlas.

comments.no-build: The repo root IS the site. No bundler: index.html loads src/*.js as native ES modules and vendor/*.js as classic scripts. Nothing below is needed to run or deploy the game.
comments.dependencies: Vendored into vendor/ by `npm run vendor`; listed here to pin the versions.
